text:
ITEM 1 | Cluster of small round green pieces, roughly half-cut, dark green outer surfaces with lighter pale green cut faces, slightly glossy and browned/charred at edges, holding shape, covering about 12% of plate in a diagonal mass about 8 cm long and 5 cm wide, piled 2 cm high, sitting left of the rice | 85
ITEM 2 | Single small round green piece with browned, slightly darker surface, isolated below the main cluster, about 2 cm across and 1.5 cm high, firm and whole | 10
ITEM 3 | Pale orange-pink grainy starch mixture, moist and clumped, with visible individual grains and some flecks of green and orange, spread across the center-right of plate in a patch about 9 cm by 6 cm, about 1.5 cm high, slightly glossy | 90
ITEM 4 | Thin curved strip of yellow-orange vegetable with slightly translucent, glossy skin and soft texture, about 7 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, lying at the top edge of the rice | 20
ITEM 5 | Cube-shaped pale tan piece with lightly browned, golden-edged surfaces, firm and dry-looking, about 2.5 cm across, sitting at the upper right of the rice | 15
ITEM 6 | Small chunks of yellow-green pepper-like pieces with glossy, slightly wrinkled skin and soft cut edges, scattered among the rice near the right side, about 5 cm total spread and 1 cm high | 25
